subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 A group of people of our country did not want our independence. They are traitors. They are enemies. They gave assistance to the Pakistani soldiers. There is no country in the world where people do not quarrel among themselves over the question of independence. We were very (a) ----- (fortunate) ----- to have such people. However, after so many years of independence, we should remove our (b) ----- (differ) ----- and work for the country united. It’s a (c) ----- (fortune) ----- for us that even after so many days of independence the traitors do make any (d) ----- (confess) -----, or they do not have forgiveness. Rather, they are still trying to have recognition of their (e) ----- (just) -- --- activities.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) unfortunate; (b) differences: (c) misfortune; (d) confession; (e) unjust.
